name: Page tree and URL sketcher
why: Plans the page tree and URLs before building, the same first step as the site build sheet skill.

name: Website quality keeper
why: A weekly check of what got slower or harder to find, which fits the monthly site care workflow.

name: Quarterly accessibility keeper
why: Ranks accessibility gaps each quarter and re-checks last quarter's fixes, extending the accessibility quick pass.

name: Font pair shortlist maker
why: Gives three headline and body font pairs with sizes and spacing for the style settings table.

name: Landing page design planner
why: Turns copy and brand into page directions and a section plan when one page needs extra design thought.

name: Customer-hero message writer
why: Writes the one-line message for the first screen, so the home page says what the business does.

name: Click choice clarity checker
why: Rates menu and button labels for clarity before they go into the build sheet.

name: Mood colour palette planner
why: Plans a small colour palette to check for contrast before setting site styles.

name: Small usability test planner
why: Plans a short test with real people on the preview site before launch.

name: Domain and certificate watch checker
why: Checks domains for leftover records and weak registrar access, useful before and after a domain move.

name: Monthly Search Console keeper
why: Reads the monthly Search Console export to see which pages to push or fix after launch.

name: Prepare your first freelance project quote
why: Turns a website brief into a quote with a clear scope, for designers pricing a site build.
